=== Diamonds: Three-Hand Vault ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3 clockwise; 'left' means the next seat clockwise. The deck has 32 cards: 4 suits (Diamonds D, Hearts H, Spades S, Clubs C), ranks 1 to 8 in each. Each player has a showroom and a vault of crystals, both starting at 0; the supply is unlimited.

The game is 3 hands of 7 tricks (21 tricks in all). In hand 1 the dealer is seat 1, in hand 2 seat 2, in hand 3 seat 3.

Start of each hand: all 32 cards are shuffled and each player is dealt 7 cards face down; the other 11 are set aside unseen. You see only your own hand, sorted by suit (D, H, S, C) and then by rank. Then everyone at the same moment secretly chooses exactly 1 card to pass to the player on their left; passes are exchanged at once and the third player is not told the card. Every player's tricks won and won cards of each suit are reset to 0.

Playing a trick: on trick 1 the player left of the dealer leads; afterwards the winner of the previous trick leads. The leader plays any card and its suit is the led suit. The other two play one card each, clockwise. If you hold a card of the led suit you must play one (you are only offered those). If you hold none, you may play any card and you immediately take the action of that card's suit, before the next player plays. All played cards are shown to everyone.

Winning a trick: the highest card of the led suit wins; off-suit cards never win. The winner takes the 3 cards, adds 1 to their tricks won and adds each suit's cards in the trick to their won count for that suit, then takes the action of the led suit once and leads the next trick.

Suit actions:
- Diamonds: move 1 crystal from the supply to your vault.
- Hearts: move 1 crystal from the supply to your showroom.
- Spades: move 1 crystal from your own showroom to your own vault. If your showroom is empty, nothing happens.
- Clubs: move 1 crystal from the showroom of the opponent whose showroom is largest into your own showroom. If both opponents tie for largest, take it from the tied opponent who sits first clockwise after you. If both opponents' showrooms are empty, nothing happens.
Every action and its result is announced to all players.

End of hand (after trick 7): for each suit in the order Diamonds, Hearts, Spades, Clubs, the player with strictly the most won cards of that suit takes that suit's action once; if the top count is tied, no one takes it. Then every player who won 0 tricks in the hand takes the Diamonds action 2 times. The dealer passes to the left for the next hand.

Showroom counts are always displayed; every change to a vault is announced. Hands, passed cards and set-aside cards are hidden.

Scoring: after hand 3, your score is 2 times your vault crystals plus your showroom crystals. The highest score wins. If players tie for highest score, the tied player with more vault crystals wins; if still tied, they share the win as a draw.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

Seats 1, 2 and 3 sit clockwise; the left of each seat is the next seat clockwise. Every showroom and vault starts empty.

Each round runs in this order: a new hand → the deal → your hand → pass a card → the passes are exchanged → your hand after the pass → clear the trick → lead a card → second seat follows → second seat off-suit action → third seat follows → third seat off-suit action → the trick is won → end of hand bonuses → final scoring → advance → after the last trick.

  third_seat_follows answer with one of the options you are given

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3 clockwise; 'left' means the next seat clockwise. The deck has 32 cards: 4 suits (Diamonds D, Hearts H, Spades S, Clubs C), ranks 1 to 8 in each. Each player has a showroom and a vault of crystals, both starting at 0; the supply is unlimited.

The game is 3 hands of 7 tricks (21 tricks in all). In hand 1 the dealer is seat 1, in hand 2 seat 2, in hand 3 seat 3.

Start of each hand: all 32 cards are shuffled and each player is dealt 7 cards face down; the other 11 are set aside unseen. You see only your own hand, sorted by suit (D, H, S, C) and then by rank. Then everyone at the same moment secretly chooses exactly 1 card to pass to the player on their left; passes are exchanged at once and the third player is not told the card. Every player's tricks won and won cards of each suit are reset to 0.

Playing a trick: on trick 1 the player left of the dealer leads; afterwards the winner of the previous trick leads. The leader plays any card and its suit is the led suit. The other two play one card each, clockwise. If you hold a card of the led suit you must play one (you are only offered those). If you hold none, you may play any card and you immediately take the action of that card's suit, before the next player plays. All played cards are shown to everyone.

Winning a trick: the highest card of the led suit wins; off-suit cards never win. The winner takes the 3 cards, adds 1 to their tricks won and adds each suit's cards in the trick to their won count for that suit, then takes the action of the led suit once and leads the next trick.

Suit actions:
- Diamonds: move 1 crystal from the supply to your vault.
- Hearts: move 1 crystal from the supply to your showroom.
- Spades: move 1 crystal from your own showroom to your own vault. If your showroom is empty, nothing happens.
- Clubs: move 1 crystal from the showroom of the opponent whose showroom is largest into your own showroom. If both opponents tie for largest, take it from the tied opponent who sits first clockwise after you. If both opponents' showrooms are empty, nothing happens.
Every action and its result is announced to all players.

End of hand (after trick 7): for each suit in the order Diamonds, Hearts, Spades, Clubs, the player with strictly the most won cards of that suit takes that suit's action once; if the top count is tied, no one takes it. Then every player who won 0 tricks in the hand takes the Diamonds action 2 times. The dealer passes to the left for the next hand.

Showroom counts are always displayed; every change to a vault is announced. Hands, passed cards and set-aside cards are hidden.

Scoring: after hand 3, your score is 2 times your vault crystals plus your showroom crystals. The highest score wins. If players tie for highest score, the tied player with more vault crystals wins; if still tied, they share the win as a draw.

Every player's tricks won and won cards of each suit are reset to 0.

Playing a trick: on trick 1 the player left of the dealer leads; afterwards the winner of the previous trick leads. The leader plays any card and its suit is the led suit. The other two play one card each, clockwise. If you hold a card of the led suit you must play one (you are only offered those). If you hold none, you may play any card and you immediately take the action of that card's suit, before the next player plays. All played cards are shown to everyone.

Winning a trick: the highest card of the led suit wins; off-suit cards never win. The winner takes the 3 cards, adds 1 to their tricks won and adds each suit's cards in the trick to their won count for that suit, then takes the action of the led suit once and leads the next trick.

- Diamonds: move 1 crystal from the supply to your vault.

Every action and its result is announced to all players.
